summary: Steep wooded verge at a cul-de-sac bend; no room to stop.

best_section.where: west side of Camp Street at the top of the hill by the bend

drivers.seclusion: House 4 m away at the start; other homes 17-19 m at the far end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street edge against steep scrubby bank; no clear ground beside the lane.
drivers.convention: Cars park lower down the street, not here.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the section most of the day.
